answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that vests only after a long, steady pulse of verified work; a fresh identity starts with no reputation and must earn it slowly. Like yarrow spreading by deep roots rather than scattered seed, trust should grow from sustained, checkable history. Add a saffron-grade cost: each new account pays a small non-refundable fee burned on creation, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs more than any single vote or payout they could steal.
